title: AInsteinBench: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Scientific Repositories
authors_zh: Titouan Duston, Shuo Xin, Yang Sun, Daoguang Zan, Aoyan Li, Shulin Xin, Kai Shen, Yixiao Chen, Qiming Sun, Ge Zhang, Jiashuo Liu, Huan Zhou, Jingkai Liu, Zhichen Pu, Yuanheng Wang, Bo-Xuan Ge, Xin Tong, Fei Ye, Zhi-Chao Zhao, Wen-Biao Han, Zhoujian Cao, Yueran Zhao, Weiluo Ren, Qingshen Long, Yuxiao Liu, Anni Huang, Yidi Du, Yuanyuan Rong, Jiahao Peng
paper_type_zh: 科学计算软件仓库的可执行智能体评测基准
best_for_zh: 需要在真实科研软件环境中检验代码智能体正确性的研究者。
one_line: AInsteinBench evaluates coding agents on executable scientific-repository tasks derived from maintainer pull requests and checked by task-specific tests.
AInsteinBench 从科学软件仓库维护者的 PR 构建可执行任务，并以任务测试检验智能体的代码修改。
why: It evaluates edits in runnable scientific environments rather than abstract programming questions.
inclusion_reason: AInsteinBench provides executable scientific-repository tasks whose agent modifications are checked by runnable tests.

title: Problem
问题
html:
General repository-level coding benchmarks mainly draw from web frameworks, utilities, and application software, testing conventional issue resolution. Scientific software additionally involves physical constraints, numerical stability, domain-specific data formats, and experimental reproducibility. A patch may pass ordinary unit tests while violating scientific meaning. Existing results therefore do not establish whether coding agents can perform real maintenance in quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, or numerical-relativity repositories.

AInsteinBench constructs executable tasks from maintainer pull requests in scientific open-source projects across six scientific domains. Each task includes a repository snapshot, problem description, reference change, test patch, Docker environment, and binary scoring rule, with multi-stage filtering and expert review. It evaluates scientific-code localization, modification, and verification by agents.

通用仓库级代码基准主要来自 Web 框架、工具库和应用软件，测试的是常规 issue 修复；科学软件还涉及物理约束、数值稳定性、领域数据格式和实验可重复性，补丁即使通过普通单测，也可能破坏科学含义。现有结果因此无法回答 coding agent 是否能在量子化学、分子动力学或数值相对论等仓库中完成真实维护工作。

AInsteinBench 从科学开源项目的 maintainer pull request 构建可执行任务，覆盖六类科学领域。每题配仓库快照、问题描述、参考修改、测试补丁、Docker 环境和二值评分规则，并经过多阶段过滤与专家审查，用于评测 agent 的科学代码定位、修改和验证能力。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The main contribution is an executable evaluation surface for scientific repositories driven by real maintainer changes. The main maintainer-PR subset contains approximately 244 tasks from quantum chemistry, quantum computing, molecular dynamics, numerical relativity, fluid dynamics, and cheminformatics projects; the release also provides subsets for difficulty and evaluation-type metadata. Records contain question identifiers, task types, descriptions, repository environments, reference answers, tests, and scoring configurations. A patch receives credit only by passing task tests in the specified container, while expert filtering removes instances requiring unavailable services, lacking sufficient descriptions, or having non-discriminative tests.

核心贡献是建立面向科学仓库、由真实维护者修改驱动的可执行评测面。主 maintainer-PR 子集包含约 244 个任务，来自量子化学、量子计算、分子动力学、数值相对论、流体力学和化学信息学项目；发布页另含难度标签与评测类型元数据子集。记录字段包括问题编号、任务类型、描述、仓库环境、参考答案、测试和评分配置。补丁必须在指定容器中通过任务测试才得分，专家筛选则用于排除依赖外部服务、描述不完整或测试无法区分正确性的实例。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select scientific repositories: Projects across six domains are chosen for domain representativeness, active maintenance, buildability, and test assets, with reproducible commits fixed.
  1. Extract authentic tasks: Maintainer pull requests are used to recover problem descriptions, base versions, and gold patches. Documentation-only changes and tasks requiring private data or unavailable services are excluded.
  1. Construct test environments: Docker configurations and test patches are created so the base commit exhibits the target failure and the reference patch restores passing behavior. Scoring configurations and commands are recorded.
  1. Filter and annotate: Automated reruns, coverage checks, and domain-expert review confirm task validity and assign difficulty and evaluation-type labels. Agent patches are ultimately judged only by tests inside the container.

1. 选择科学仓库： 按领域代表性、维护活跃度、可构建性和测试资产选择六类科学项目，并锁定可复现提交。
  1. 提取真实任务： 从 maintainer PR 还原问题描述、基础版本和 gold patch，排除纯文档、依赖私有数据或无法独立执行的修改。
  1. 构造测试环境： 编写 Docker 配置和 test patch，使基础提交呈现目标失败、参考补丁恢复通过；同时记录评分配置与运行命令。
  1. 过滤与标注： 通过自动运行、覆盖检查和领域专家复核确认任务有效，并标注难度与评测类型。最终 agent 补丁只由容器中的测试结果判定。

title: Evidence
证据
html: AInsteinBench’s credibility primarily comes from task provenance and two-layer validation rather than a single model leaderboard. Approximately 244 main tasks trace back to maintainer pull requests in real scientific repositories across six computational-science domains. Base commits, reference patches, and tests are replayed in isolated environments, while experts check whether tasks require domain knowledge and whether tests discriminate correct patches. Evaluations of multiple coding agents show that scientific tasks remain difficult and analyze failures by difficulty and error type. This supports benchmark realism, but the limited set of repositories cannot represent the entire scientific-software ecosystem.

AInsteinBench 的可信度主要来自任务来源和双层验证，而不是单一模型排行榜。主集约 244 个任务均回溯到真实科学仓库的维护者 PR，覆盖六个计算科学领域；基础提交、参考补丁和测试在隔离环境中重放，并由专家检查问题是否需要领域知识、测试是否能判别正确补丁。论文对多种 coding agent 的评测显示科学任务仍显著困难，并按难度和错误类型分析失败。该证据支持基准的现实性，但仓库数量有限，不能代表全部科研软件生态。

title: Novelty
新意
html: SWE-bench and related benchmarks use authentic repository issues, but they predominantly cover conventional software engineering and generally treat test success as a sufficient correctness proxy. AInsteinBench retains the repository-snapshot, patch, and container-execution framework while changing task provenance and audit targets: it selects scientific-software maintainer pull requests and adds domain-expert checks of scientific semantics, numerical behavior, and test discriminativeness. Its novelty is not a new agent architecture but the inclusion of scientific-computing constraints in instance selection and verification, distinguishing generic code modification from scientific-software maintenance.

SWE-bench 及其衍生基准关注真实仓库 issue，但主体仍是常规软件工程，通常将测试通过视为足够的正确性代理。AInsteinBench 沿用仓库快照、补丁和容器执行的基本框架，却改变了任务来源与审计对象：只选科学软件维护者 PR，并增加领域专家对科学语义、数值行为和测试判别力的检查。其新意不是新的 agent 架构，而是把科学计算约束纳入实例选择和验证合同，使评测能够区分“会修改代码”与“能维护科研代码”。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limited domains and repositories: Six domains and a small set of high-quality projects cannot cover ecosystems such as scientific instrumentation, climate simulation, or bioinformatics. Rankings may depend on repository-specific styles.
  1. Tests remain proxies: Expert review improves quality, but passing tests does not guarantee numerical accuracy, long-term stability, or correct scientific conclusions. High-risk tasks need property tests and tolerance audits.
  1. Environment aging: Scientific software depends on compilers, CPU/GPU libraries, and data files, so containers may become unbuildable. Reuse should verify image digests, hardware requirements, and full-task replay rates.

1. 领域与仓库有限： 六个领域和少量高质量项目无法覆盖实验仪器、气候模拟或生物信息学等生态；模型排名可能受具体代码风格影响。
  1. 测试仍是代理： 专家审查提高了质量，但测试通过不保证数值误差、长期稳定性或科学结论完全正确。高风险任务应增加属性测试和结果容差审计。
  1. 环境老化： 科学软件依赖编译器、GPU/CPU 库和数据文件，容器随时间可能不可构建。复用前要校验镜像摘要、硬件要求和全部任务的重放率。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Scientific coding-agent evaluation: Run agents with fixed containers and inference budgets, reporting resolution, build-failure, domain, and difficulty scores separately so aggregate means do not hide failure in a scientific field.
  1. Verified training: Use problems, repositories, and tests as RLVR environments with terminal rewards from test success. Gold patches should remain audit assets and must not be exposed to policy models.
  1. Data-expansion template: Select maintainer pull requests from additional research projects and reuse the base-fails, gold-passes, expert-semantic-review pipeline. Repositories whose licences, data dependencies, or hardware cannot be packaged should not be forced into public tasks.

1. 科学 coding agent 评测： 在固定容器和推理预算下运行 agent，分别报告任务解决率、构建失败率、领域分数和难度分数，避免用总体均值掩盖某一科学领域的失效。
  1. 可验证训练： 将问题、仓库和测试作为 RLVR 环境，使用测试通过提供终局奖励；参考补丁只用于审计，不能泄露给策略模型。
  1. 数据扩展模板： 从其他科研项目筛选 maintainer PR，复用“基础提交失败—gold patch 通过—专家语义复核”的流程。若仓库许可证、数据依赖或硬件无法封装，不应强行转为公开任务。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence position: AInsteinBench extends repository-level agent evaluation to scientific software, requiring patches to satisfy both engineering tests and domain semantics.
  2. Method takeaway: Maintainer-PR extraction, container replay, task tests, and scientific-expert review jointly determine instance quality.
  3. Data takeaway: The main set has about 244 tasks across six scientific domains, with environments, answers, tests, scoring, and difficulty metadata.
  4. Evidence anchor: Every task derives from an authentic PR and supports executable verification; repository and domain coverage remain the main boundary.
  5. Reuse decision: It suits scientific coding agents; users must verify container replay and test coverage of numerical semantics.

1. 一句话定位： AInsteinBench 把仓库级 agent 评测推进到科学软件，要求补丁同时满足工程测试和领域语义。
  2. 方法抓手： maintainer PR 提取、容器重放、任务测试与科学专家复核共同保证实例质量。
  3. 数据抓手： 主集约 244 题，覆盖六个科学领域，并发布环境、答案、测试、评分与难度元数据。
  4. 证据锚点： 所有任务均由真实 PR 派生并可执行验证；结论边界是仓库和领域覆盖仍小。
  5. 复用决定： 适合科研代码 agent；使用前必须检查容器重放率和测试对数值语义的覆盖。
